gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: She would rather ___ at home tonight.
gaps.explanation: 'Would rather do' — the bare infinitive follows.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.

gaps.sentence: She can't afford ___ her car repaired this month.
gaps.explanation: afford + to-infinitive: can't afford to get.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.
bother + -ing (or to-infinitive): don't bother going. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.
